issues.span: 有多少無諸相具足，即有多少非虛妄
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'ji tsam du mtshan phun sum tshogs pa med pa de tsam du mi brdzun te' is a correlative 'to whatever extent ... to that extent' (degree), per Chone Drakpa Shedrub 2-23 ('ji tsam du ... bden par med pa de tsam ni mi brdzun'). The Chinese 有多少...有多少 reads as counting quantities of things, and 無諸相具足 is hard to parse.
issues.fix: 在無諸相具足的程度上，即在同等程度上非虛妄，

issues.span: 具足戒、具足功德、具足般若
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'tshul khrims dang ldan pa, yon tan dang ldan pa, shes rab dang ldan pa' = 'possessing ethical discipline / qualities / wisdom' (Skt. guṇavantaḥ śīlavantaḥ prajñāvantaḥ). 具足戒 is the fixed Chinese term for full ordination vows (upasampadā), and 具足 also collides with the locked 諸相具足 (phun sum tshogs pa) in 6-7. The commentary (Chone 2-26) means the three trainings, not ordination.
issues.fix: 具有戒、具有功德、具有般若

issues.span: 無眾生想，無壽者想，因為將不會生起人想。
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'sems can du 'du shes pa ma yin | srog tu 'du shes pa ma yin | gang zag tu 'du shes 'jug par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro' is a single series; the closing 'phyir ro' answers the 'why?' of 6-19 for the whole series (self, sentient being, life-force, person). The Chinese 因為 attaches only to the last item, so it reads as if the person-perception explains the first two.
issues.fix: 無眾生想，無壽者想，亦不會生起人想，故如此。
